title: DNA extraction and Nanopore library prep
author: Bernard Y Kim
materials: Thaw NEBNext repair and dA-tailing mixes and buffers from the Nanopore Companion Module. Mix buffers by vortexing and enzyme mixes by flicking. Spin down tubes and keep chilled on ice. NEBNext Companion Module forOxford Nanopore Technologies Ligation Sequencing – 24 rxns New England Biolabs Catalog #E7180S
Briefly spin down the tube to collect condensation.

steps.title: Transfer fly to LoBind tube
steps.instruction: Place a fly on filter paper, dab briefly with a Kimwipe to remove excess ethanol, and transfer the fly into a 1.5 mL LoBind tube (Eppendorf Cat #0030108051).

steps.title: Hydrate fly in Buffer STE
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer STE (400 mM NaCl, 20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 30 mM EDTA) to the tube, then incubate on a platform rocker or rotator at low‑to‑medium speed for 15 min.

steps.title: Refresh Buffer STE incubation
steps.instruction: Replace the solution with 500 µL fresh Buffer STE and incubate again on the rocker at low‑to‑medium speed for another 15 min.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and homogenize
steps.instruction: Add 283 µL Lysis Buffer (0.1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 0.1 M NaCl, 20 mM EDTA) to the tube and manually homogenize the fly with a pellet pestle, crushing soft tissue while leaving larger cuticle pieces intact.

steps.title: Proteinase‑K/SDS/RNase digestion
steps.instruction: Add 7.5 µL 20 mg/mL Proteinase K, 7.5 µL 10 % SDS, and 2 µL 20 mg/mL RNase A; flick to mix, then incubate at 50 °C for 2–4 h, gently mixing every 45 min. After incubation, pipette off as much liquid as possible without drying the fly tissue.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to phase‑lock tube
steps.instruction: Briefly spin the homogenate/lysis mixture (≈30 s at 15 000 × g, room temperature), then decant or pipette the supernatant into a 2 mL phase‑lock gel tube (LoBind).

steps.title: First PCI extraction
steps.instruction: Add ~350 µL Tris‑saturated phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1, pH 8.0, Fisher Cat #BP1752I‑400) inside a fume hood, rock at medium speed for 8 min, then centrifuge at 16 000 × g for 8 min to separate phases.

steps.title: Second PCI extraction
steps.instruction: Add another ~350 µL PCI to the same phase‑lock tube, rock 8 min, and centrifuge again at 16 000 × g for 8 min.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume (~350 µL) chloroform (Merck Cat #CX1055‑6), rock at medium speed for 8 min, then centrifuge at 16 000 × g for 8 min.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Quickly decant the top aqueous layer into a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind tube; avoid touching the phase‑lock gel with the pipette tip and leave a few drops behind to prevent gel collapse.

steps.title: Prepare 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Chill 100 % ethanol on ice and mix 500 µL of it with nuclease‑free water to make 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Add sodium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 volume (typically 30 µL) of 3 M sodium acetate to the aqueous sample and swirl gently to mix.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 2–2.5 volumes (typically 675 µL) cold 100 % ethanol, then swirl and gently rock to mix; DNA may be invisible, and occasional clouding indicates salt precipitation.

steps.title: Pellet DNA by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5 000 × g, 4 °C for 5 min; the DNA pellet will often be invisible.

steps.title: Remove supernatant ethanol
steps.instruction: Carefully pipette off the ethanol without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: First 70 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 70 % ethanol, swirl gently, then centrifuge at 5 000 × g, 4 °C for 2 min.

steps.title: Second 70 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Pipette off the supernatant, add another 200 µL 70 % ethanol, centrifuge at 5 000 × g, 4 °C for 2 min, then remove the supernatant (brief spin and use a P10 tip for the last drops).

steps.title: Air‑dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Allow the tube to air‑dry for no more than 1 min; do not over‑dry.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in Tris
steps.instruction: Add 42 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, incubate at 50 °C for 30 min, and pipette up and down the back of the tube several times to fully resuspend.

steps.title: Brief spin and store
steps.instruction: Briefly spin down to collect condensation and store the tube at 4 °C.

steps.title: Pipette‑mix DNA five times
steps.instruction: Using a P200 tip, pipette the solution slowly five times to ensure homogeneity.

steps.title: Quantify DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure 1 µL aliquots with Qubit and Nanodrop; aim for >250 ng total DNA with 260/280 > 1.8 and 260/230 > 2.0.

steps.title: Reserve DNA for Illumina prep
steps.instruction: Set aside at least 20 ng gDNA in 6 µL Tris and store at –20 °C for later Illumina library preparation.

steps.title: Set up repair/end‑prep reaction
steps.instruction: Transfer the remaining DNA (up to 40 µL) to a 0.2 mL PCR tube, dilute with nuclease‑free water to 48.5 µL, then add 3.5 µL FFPE DNA repair buffer, 3.5 µL end‑prep buffer, 2 µL FFPE DNA repair mix, and 3 µL end‑prep mix; flick or gently pipette with a cut‑off P200 tip to mix.

steps.title: Thermal‑cycle repair/end‑prep
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a thermal cycler: 20 °C for 1 h, then 65 °C for 30 min; hold at 4 °C afterwards.

steps.title: Bind DNA to AMPure beads
steps.instruction: Using a cut‑off P200 tip, transfer the reaction to a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind tube, add 60 µL AMPure XP beads, and mix gently by flicking.

steps.title: Incubate beads for binding
steps.instruction: Let the mixture sit at room temperature for at least 5 min; meanwhile prepare fresh 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: First bead ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack for 5 min until cleared, pipette off the supernatant, add 175 µL 70 % ethanol, and pipette slowly with the tip touching the tube wall.

steps.title: Second bead ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol wash: add another 175 µL 70 % ethanol, gently mix, then remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Dry beads and elute in water
steps.instruction: Briefly spin the tube, place it back on the magnet, remove any remaining drops with a P10 tip, then add 31 µL nuclease‑free water and resuspend the bead pellet.

steps.title: Heat‑incubate eluate
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on a heat block at 50 °C for 30 min, flicking gently every 5 min to keep beads suspended.

steps.title: Magnet clean‑up after elution
steps.instruction: Briefly spin, return the tube to the magnetic rack for 5 min until cleared.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to new tube
steps.instruction: Using a cut‑off P200 tip, transfer the 31 µL eluate to a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind tube.

steps.title: Check library recovery
steps.instruction: Measure 1 µL with Qubit; expect at least 150 ng DNA.

steps.title: Thaw ligation reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw AMXII, T4 ligase, LNB, and LFB from the NEBNext Nanopore Companion Module and keep on ice; flick to mix AMXII, T4 ligase, and LFB, pipette‑mix LNB, then spin down briefly.

steps.title: Assemble ligation mix
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL prepared DNA, 2.5 µL AMXII, and 5 µL T4 ligase to a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind tube and flick to mix.

steps.title: Add LNB and mix
steps.instruction: Add 12.5 µL LNB, mix gently with a wide‑bore tip (DNA may precipitate; avoid loss).

steps.title: Ligation incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the ligation mixture at room temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: Post‑ligation bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL AMPure XP beads, mix by flick, and let sit for at least 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: First LFB bead wash
steps.instruction: Pellet beads on a magnetic rack for 5 min, remove supernatant, add 100 µL LFB (Ligation Sequencing Kit buffer), and flick to mix (do not use ethanol).

steps.title: Second LFB bead wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the LFB wash: pellet beads again, remove supernatant, add another 100 µL LFB, flick, then pellet.

steps.title: Elute library in EB
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed beads in 26 µL Elution Buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0).

steps.title: Incubate eluate
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on a heat block at 37 °C for 15 min, flicking every 5 min.

steps.title: Magnet clear and collect library
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack for 5 min until cleared, then transfer the 26 µL eluate to a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind tube.

steps.title: Quantify final library
steps.instruction: Measure library concentration with Qubit using 1 µL of the eluate.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw one tube each of sequencing buffer SBII, loading solution LS, flush buffer FB, and flush tether FLT; flick SBII, LS, and FB together, pipette‑mix FLT, spin down, and keep all reagents on ice.

steps.title: Load library onto flow cell
steps.instruction: Transfer at least 100 ng of library (≤25 µL) to a fresh LoBind tube, add LS to bring the volume to 25 µL, then add 25 µL SBII for a total of 50 µL. Follow the official ONT instructions to prime the flow cell and load the library using a wide‑bore tip, mixing gently before loading.

steps.title: Optional flow‑cell flushing
steps.instruction: During a sequencing run, flush the flow cell at 10–14 hour intervals with the ONT Flowcell Wash Kit (EXP‑WSH003) to reactivate clogged pores.
